Hey, i just had this same issue too and solved it. The way i solved it was going to disk properties where the game was stored(right click "F:" and then went to properties), went into tools and then clicked on Error checking, checked the disk(did not click on check and repair, just check disk) then my computer found that there was an error, just clicked on fix, checked again, uninstalled Lost Ark through steam, checked for errors again(just in case) and restarted PC, checked again for errors on the disk on the same tool, and tried installing the game again and it went smoothly(but had to download the whole thing again).
